_note: live-public-livestream (liv-06, liv-10, liv-19, liv-22): a public broadcast of a meeting is its own record, so the anonymous read predicate covers exactly what a resident may see and never the private meeting (design D1). The states are a declarative lifecycle (D2). Numbered 120, not the 92 the design names: 92 was taken.

MeetingBroadcast.title: Meeting broadcast
MeetingBroadcast.description: A public livestream of a meeting: its status, the player and recording addresses, the broadcast parts and the released captions. Readable without an account once its publication date has passed.

meeting.title: Meeting
meeting.description: The meeting this broadcast shows; one broadcast per meeting.

title.title: Title
title.description: The meeting's title, copied when the broadcast is made, so the public row needs no private meeting.

bodyName.title: Body
bodyName.description: The name of the body that meets, copied when the broadcast is made.

scheduledDate.title: Scheduled date
scheduledDate.description: When the meeting starts, copied when the broadcast is made.

lifecycle.title: Status
lifecycle.description: planned until a clerk tests or goes live; a test ends back in planned; live and paused alternate until the broadcast ends.

previewUrl.title: Preview address
previewUrl.description: The staff preview of a test. Never shown on the portal.

playerUrl.title: Player address
playerUrl.description: The public player, written when the broadcast goes live.

recordingUrl.title: Recording address
recordingUrl.description: The streaming service's public recording, written after the broadcast ended.

testResult.title: Test result
testResult.description: What the clerk found in the last test.

testNote.title: Test note
testNote.description: The clerk's note on the last test.

liveCaptions.title: Live captions
liveCaptions.description: Whether the streaming service was asked for live captions, cannot give them, or they are off.

publicWindows.title: Public windows
publicWindows.description: The parts of the meeting that were broadcast: seconds from the meeting start, and where each part begins in the recording.

captionTracks.title: Caption tracks
captionTracks.description: Reviewed subtitle files released with the recording.

publicationDate.title: Publication date
publicationDate.description: From this moment anyone can read the broadcast without an account.

depublicationDate.title: Depublication date
depublicationDate.description: When the broadcast stops being public.

x-openregister-lifecycle._note: Declarative broadcast states (ADR-031, live-public-livestream D2). A test ends back in planned; ended is terminal. MeetingBroadcastService moves the state through OpenRegister and never sets it by hand.
